newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Megaworld sees 1997 net at 2.8 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Megaworld sees 1997 net at 2.8 bln pesos.

text.p: Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc said on Tuesday that it expected its 1997 net profit to reach 2.8 billion pesos.
It earlier reported a net income of 2.69 billion pesos in 1996, inclusive of extraordinary gains. Its 1995 net profit was 957.5 million pesos.
Megaworld's housing development subsidiary, Empire East Land Holdings, said it expected net income in 1997 to reach 1.94 billion pesos, up from 1.57 billion in 1996.
"We're on track to complete ten more projects this year," Megaworld vice president Cirilo Manlangit said in a statement.
He said sales of residential, office and mixed-use projects contributed to the robust growth in the company's revenues last year.
Megaworld' earnings per share was at 1.43 pesos in 1996 versus 0.51 peso in 1995.
